title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate Module Master's/Doctoral Seminar: Course Registration for Credit
summary: Current graduate students who have completed auditing of their module's Master's/Doctoral Seminar and wish to take it for credit must register for the course during the Fall 2026 course registration period. The registration schedule (Section 2) was not included in the notice text; it may be in an image or in Attachment 1, which were not read. Students must register for the seminar offered by their own (advisor's) module, choosing a course from the 16 listed in Attachment 2.
applies_to: Current graduate students (재학생) who have completed auditing (청강) of their module's Master's or Doctoral Seminar and wish to take it for credit in Fall 2026. The seminar is a mandatory requirement for completion of master's and doctoral coursework. Integrated master's-doctoral program students must complete both the Master's Seminar and the Doctoral Seminar separately.

dates.what: Course registration period for the Master's/Doctoral Seminar for credit (schedule not included in the notice text; see the original notice or Attachment 1)
English Presentation Skills Seminar, online via Zoom (planned; details to be announced later). Optional for auditing students; recommended in the credit semester

conditions: The module Master's/Doctoral Seminar is a requirement for completing the master's and doctoral programs and must be taken before completion.
The seminar runs over two semesters: the first semester is auditing only, without course registration; in the second semester you register, give a presentation in English and earn 3 credits.
Do not formally register for the seminar in your first (auditing) semester.

Integrated master's-doctoral program students must complete the Master's Seminar (audit in semester 1, register and present in semester 2) and the Doctoral Seminar (audit in semester 4, register and present in semester 5), based on entering the doctoral stage in semester 4.
Only the 16 courses listed in Attachment 2 count as the required seminar; courses with the same name but a different subtitle code or subtitle name count only as general graduate courses.
You must register for the course offered by your own (advisor's) module, with the same subtitle name as the course you audited.

Exception for Fall 2026 only, limited to the Master's Seminars of the Semiconductor and Computer modules (courses added this semester): you may register for the course matching your presentation topic even if its subtitle name differs from the course you audited last semester.

Auditing and taking the course for credit should normally be in two consecutive semesters; if this is not possible, you must report to the teaching assistant in advance so the case is not missed at handover.
If a problem arises because auditing and credit were not taken consecutively, the student is responsible.
The English Presentation Skills Seminar is not mandatory for auditing students; only those who wish may apply.
steps: Read Attachment 1 (Fall 2026 required Master's/Doctoral Seminar registration guide for current students) and Attachment 2 (list of the 16 module seminar courses and teaching assistants) attached to the original notice; their contents were not read for this translation.
Check the course registration schedule in Section 2 of the original notice or in Attachment 1 (not included in the text).

Identify the seminar course offered by your own (advisor's) module in Attachment 2, with the same subtitle name as the course you audited (Semiconductor and Computer module Master's Seminar students may instead choose the course matching their presentation topic, Fall 2026 only).
Register for that course during the course registration period.
If you cannot audit and take the course for credit in consecutive semesters, report this to the module's teaching assistant in advance.
Optionally, apply for the English Presentation Skills Seminar (Zoom, 4 September 2026, 2:00–3:00 p.m.) once details are announced.
For questions, contact the department office, Building 301, Room 319; contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Graduate Module 'Master's/Doctoral Seminar' (석박세미나) Course Registration for Credit (수강) Guide (Current Students / Students Taking the Course)

We announce course registration (수강신청) for credit for the Fall 2026 graduate module 'Master's/Doctoral Seminar' courses. Current students who have completed auditing (청강) and wish to take the course for credit must register during the period below.

1. Overview of the graduate module 'Master's/Doctoral Seminar'
- It is a mandatory requirement for completion of the master's and doctoral programs. Master's and doctoral seminars for each module are offered every semester, and you must take the one for your module before completion.
- It runs as a two-semester course: the first semester is conducted as auditing (청강) without course registration, and in the second semester you earn 3 credits through course registration and an English presentation.
- Integrated master's-doctoral program (석박사통합과정) students must complete the 'Master's Seminar' and the 'Doctoral Seminar' separately (based on entering the doctoral stage in the 4th semester).
  · Master's Seminar: audit in the 1st semester → register and present in the 2nd semester (3 credits)
  · Doctoral Seminar: audit in the 4th semester → register and present in the 5th semester (3 credits)
  ※ In the first semester of each (1st and 4th semesters), you do not formally register; you only audit.

2. Course registration schedule
[The schedule was not included in the text of the notice. It may be in an image or in the attachments, which were not read.]

3. English Presentation Skills Seminar (details to be announced later)
- Date, time and place: Friday, 4 September 2026, 2:00–3:00 p.m., planned online (Zoom)
- Content: a lecture on English presentation skills.
- Note: participation is not mandatory for auditing students; only those who wish may apply (participation is recommended in the semester you take the course for credit).

4. Important notes
a. Courses with the same name other than the 16 courses in [Attachment 2] are not the required Master's/Doctoral Seminar; they count as general graduate courses (their subtitle code/subtitle name differs).
b. The first semester of the module Master's/Doctoral Seminar is conducted as auditing, so take care not to formally register for that course during the registration period.
c. You must register for the course offered by your own (advisor's) module (you may register for the course offered with the same subtitle name as the course you previously audited).
  ※ [Fall 2026 Master's Seminar exception]
   · Applies to: only the Master's Seminars of the 'Semiconductor' (반도체) and 'Computer' (컴퓨터) modules, for which courses were added this semester
   · Period: Fall 2026 only
   · Exception: even if the subtitle name does not match the course you audited last semester, you may register for the course corresponding to your presentation topic.
d. In principle, auditing and taking the course for credit must be done in two consecutive semesters. If it is unavoidably difficult to do them consecutively, you must report this to the teaching assistant in charge in advance so that it is not missed at handover. Please note that the student is responsible if a problem arises.

5. Inquiries: department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person's details are given in the original notice.
